name: Tramsheds Series Saturday 2022
information: This is a **series competition** alonside [Tramsheds Series Sunday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TramshedsSeriesSunday2022). **You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the two competitions.** If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each day has a slightly different set of events. There is a strict limit of ONE GUEST PER COMPETITOR. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
